content.content: The creation position is the dependency furthest up (newest) in jj history: the new change is inserted immediately after it via `jj new -A`, and the node's other dependencies are its ancestors. The position is the unique head of the dependency set.
content.rationale: Appending after the newest dependency keeps the jj stack linear — the birth extends the timeline instead of forking it — while `depends_on` still names every prerequisite. Inserting after, rather than `jj new <dep>`, stays linear even when the dependency already has children.
